'''2011 Bespin Regionals Mark Walseth DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)|VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Walseth
* '''Deck name:''' Walkers
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
